description:
So weathergirl john doe is official now..

So we're back with a new Forsaken UST by making a Last Man Standing for them! I decided to feature Eleanor Forte on this since she's the voice singing in the original weathergirl by Flavor Foley!

(this is actually a remake of an old lms i did for this concept like a year ago lol)

If you enjoyed this, make sure to like and subscribe as it helps me out a ton! And make sure to comment E to boost the algorithm.. mu ha ha...
